definitions.explanation: A small building or enclosure for keeping and raising animals. Commonly associated with small animals kept at Japanese elementary schools.

examples.japanese: {飼育小屋|しいくごや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧うさぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}っている→飼う：08151_kau⟧。
examples.english: We keep rabbits in the animal pen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飼育小屋|しいくごや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鶏|にわとり}→鶏：05202_niwatori⟧がいた。
examples.english: There were chickens in the elementary school's animal shed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当番|とうばん}→当番：04564_touban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧、{飼育小屋|しいくごや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{餌|えさ}やり→餌やり：22010_esayari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しなければ→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ならなかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: On duty days, I had to come to school early in the morning to clean the animal shed and feed the animals.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{飼育|しいく}→飼育：06422_shiiku⟧ (raising/breeding animals) and ⟦{小屋|こや}→小屋：02768_koya⟧ (hut/shed). Many Japanese elementary schools have a {飼育小屋|しいくごや} where students take turns caring for small animals like rabbits, chickens, or guinea pigs as part of their education in responsibility and life science.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飼育小屋|しいくごや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧ — cleaning the animal shed
- {飼育小屋|しいくごや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{当番|とうばん}→当番：04564_touban⟧ — animal shed duty
- {飼育小屋|しいくごや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧ — to build an animal pen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小屋|こや}→小屋：02768_koya⟧ — hut; shed (general term for a small structure)
- {鶏小屋|とりごや} — chicken coop (specifically for chickens)
- {犬小屋|いぬごや} — doghouse
- {牛舎|ぎゅうしゃ} — cattle barn (larger, for livestock farming)
